structured_output.title: Short name alias added for Issuer resource
structured_output.content: This change adds kubectl short name `iss` for cert-manager `Issuer` resources. Your environment runs cert-manager (uses Certificate CRD), which typically depends on `Issuer` resources. The environment summary does not explicitly list `issuers.cert-manager.io` CRD, so verify whether your cert-manager installation includes Issuer resources. If present, users can now reference them via `kubectl get iss` after upgrade.
